question_en: Across all vehicles delivered, including those with no claims, which model year and powertrain combination has the highest total warranty cost divided by the number of vehicles delivered in that combination, and what is that figure?
question_es: Considerando todos los vehículos entregados, incluidos los que no tienen ninguna reclamación, ¿qué combinación de año de modelo y tren motriz tiene el mayor coste total de garantía dividido entre el número de vehículos entregados de esa combinación, y cuál es esa cifra?
reference_sql: SELECT v.model_year, v.powertrain, sum(w.cost_eur)/count(DISTINCT v.vin) AS cost_per_vehicle FROM vehicles v JOIN warranty_claims w ON w.vin=v.vin GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: How many high-voltage battery warranty claims were opened on model year 2023 BEV vehicles?
question_es: ¿Cuántas reclamaciones de garantía de batería de alta tensión se abrieron en vehículos BEV del año 2023?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM warranty_claims w JOIN vehicles v ON v.vin=w.vin WHERE w.component='battery_hv' AND v.model_year=2023 AND v.powertrain='BEV'

question_en: What is the total warranty cost in euros across the whole fleet?
question_es: ¿Cuál es el coste total de garantía en euros de toda la flota?

question_en: How many vehicles are in the fleet?
Which market has the highest total warranty cost?
question_es: ¿Qué mercado tiene el mayor coste total de garantía?
reference_sql: SELECT market, sum(cost_eur) FROM warranty_claims GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: What share of total charging energy was delivered at public DC chargers, as a percentage?
question_es: ¿Qué porcentaje de la energía total de carga se entregó en cargadores públicos de DC?
reference_sql: SELECT 100*sum(CASE WHEN location_type='public_dc' THEN energy_kwh END)/sum(energy_kwh) FROM charging_sessions

question_en: What is the average cost of a closed and paid warranty claim?
question_es: ¿Cuál es el coste medio de una reclamación de garantía cerrada y pagada?
reference_sql: SELECT avg(cost_eur) FROM warranty_claims WHERE status='closed_paid'

question_en: Which customer segment accounts for the most warranty cost?
question_es: ¿Qué segmento de cliente acumula más coste de garantía?
reference_sql: SELECT c.segment, sum(w.cost_eur) FROM warranty_claims w JOIN vehicles v ON v.vin=w.vin JOIN fleet_customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: How many distinct diagnostic trouble codes appear in the fault events?
question_es: ¿Cuántos códigos de diagnóstico distintos aparecen en los eventos de fallo?

question_en: What percentage of fault events resulted in a warranty claim?
question_es: ¿Qué porcentaje de eventos de fallo derivó en una reclamación de garantía?
reference_sql: SELECT 100*count(DISTINCT w.event_id)/(SELECT count(*) FROM fault_events) FROM warranty_claims w
